g.text: C6 STEP 9 / EVENT INPUTS / EDGES TIMESTAMPED BY MCU TIMER (GPIOTE+PPI), SAME PATH AS ADC DRDY

g.desc: C6 STEP 9 / EVENT INPUTS / EDGES TIMESTAMPED BY MCU TIMER (GPIOTE+PPI), SAME PATH AS ADC DRDY

g.text: ISOLATION BARRIER: J600, R600, D600 and U600 pins 1-3 form the isolated side. Keep >= 8 mm creepage and clearance

g.desc: ISOLATION BARRIER: J600, R600, D600 and U600 pins 1-3 form the isolated side. Keep >= 8 mm creepage and clearance

g.text: to all other copper (slot under U600). J600 shell is NOT board GND. Input: 3.0-5.0 V logic, active HIGH, 2-6 mA LED current.

g.desc: to all other copper (slot under U600). J600 shell is NOT board GND. Input: 3.0-5.0 V logic, active HIGH, 2-6 mA LED current.

g.text: U600 output is inverting: trigger HIGH -> TRIGGER_ISO LOW. Firmware captures both edges.

g.desc: U600 output is inverting: trigger HIGH -> TRIGGER_ISO LOW. Firmware captures both edges.

g.text: PHOTODIODE: passive sensor only (e.g. BPW34 on screen). Not isolated: participant-side circuit like the electrodes.

g.desc: PHOTODIODE: passive sensor only (e.g. BPW34 on screen). Not isolated: participant-side circuit like the electrodes.

g.text: TIA: Vout = 50 mV + Iph x 33k, BW ~320 kHz. Threshold set by DAC after SAADC calibration on PHOTO_MONITOR; POR code 0 = no edges.

g.desc: TIA: Vout = 50 mV + Iph x 33k, BW ~320 kHz. Threshold set by DAC after SAADC calibration on PHOTO_MONITOR; POR code 0 = no edges.
